# v1.1 (macOS 15 Sequoia): native Wi-Fi front end

> Experimental, AI-written, tested on one laptop (ASUS GA403WM). Kernel code: it can panic. Back up first.
> **macOS 15 Sequoia (24H32) only**: the native kext's Apple ABI is specific to that build. For macOS 26 Tahoe use the latest `v2.*`.

Copied from [ga403wm-hackintosh `kext-v1.1`](https://github.com/thanhnndev/ga403wm-hackintosh/releases/tag/kext-v1.1) (2026-10-14),
Wi-Fi files only. The binaries are unchanged; `SHA256SUMS.txt` was regenerated for this subset.

* **`itlmt7925Native.kext` (new, opt-in):** the MT7925 shows up as a real Wi-Fi interface, with the Wi-Fi menu and WPA2-PSK join from
  System Settings, and no password in the kext. Measured: 28-36 MB/s on one TCP stream, `networkQuality` 293 Mb/s down / 45 Mb/s up.
* **`itlmt7925.kext` (core):** link-loss recovery with firmware reload, MAC address from the firmware, RX ring 512. **A-MSDU off by default.**

| File | What | Install |
|---|---|---|
| `itlmt7925.kext.zip` | core driver, needed in both modes. Credentials empty | `EFI/OC/Kexts`, first |
| `itlmt7925Native.kext.zip` | native front end, does nothing without `itlmt_native=1` | after the core, `MaxKernel 24.99.99` |
| `ItlWiFi.app.zip` | menu bar app for legacy mode | |

Native mode boot-args: `itlmt_native=1 itlmt_native_if=1 itlmt_native_dp=1 itlmt_fast=6`. Full steps: [docs/GUIDE.md](https://github.com/thanhnndev/mt7925-macos-wifi/blob/main/docs/GUIDE.md).
